title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisons of G.L. c 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of January, February, and March, 1989. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective coast of burning coal and oil.
